CoxphControl#summary.en: Control of the Newton-Raphson iterations of {@link coxph} (R's `coxph.control`).

CoxphControl.eps#summary.en: Convergence tolerance on the relative change of the log partial likelihood. Default 1e-9.

CoxphControl.tolerChol#summary.en: Tolerance of the pivots of the Cholesky factorisation. Default 2^-39 (eps^0.75 for the machine eps 2^-52).

CoxphControl.tolerInf#summary.en: Tolerance of the check for infinite coefficients. Default sqrt(`eps`).

CoxphOptions.confLevel#summary.en: Confidence level of the intervals of exp(coef). Default 0.95.

CoxphOptions.nocenter#summary.en: Covariates whose values all lie in this set are neither centred nor scaled. Default `[-1, 0, 1]`.

CoxphOptions.strata#summary.en: Stratum labels, one per observation: a separate baseline hazard per stratum.

CoxphOptions.ties#summary.en: Handling of tied event times. Default `"efron"`.

CoxphOptions.weights#summary.en: Case weights (positive integers; other weights make R use a robust variance, which is not supported yet).

CoxphResult.coefficients#summary.en: Coefficients (NaN for R's NA: an aliased column or one whose information fell below the tolerance)

CoxphResult.iter#summary.en: Number of iterations (`iterMax + 1` when they ran out)

CoxphResult.linearPredictors#summary.en: Linear predictors (centred by the means), one per observation used, in input order

CoxphResult.loglik#summary.en: Log partial likelihood at the starting values and at the end

CoxphResult.means#summary.en: The means used to centre the covariates (0 for the columns not centred)

CoxphResult.rsq#summary.en: R^2 (1 - exp(-logtest / n)) and its maximum (1 - exp(2 loglik[0] / n))

CoxphResult.score#summary.en: The score test statistic at the starting values

CoxphResult.var#summary.en: Variance matrix of the coefficients (array of rows)

CoxphResult.wald#summary.en: The Wald statistic of the non-NA coefficients (against `init` when given)

CoxphResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in order of first appearance.

CoxphTest#summary.en: A test statistic with its degrees of freedom and upper chi-squared tail.

SurvdiffOptions.rho#summary.en: Exponent of the weights S(t-)^rho (pooled Kaplan-Meier estimate just before each event time). Default 0.

SurvdiffResult.df#summary.en:
Degrees of freedom: (number of groups with a positive expected count) - 1, or the rank of the variance matrix of
those groups (all but the first) when it is singular

SurvdiffResult.exp#summary.en: Weighted expected number of events per group

SurvdiffResult.groups#summary.en: R's names of the groups, `"group=<label>"`, in the order of the sorted labels

SurvdiffResult.obs#summary.en: Weighted observed number of events per group

SurvdiffResult.pvalue#summary.en: Upper chi-squared tail on `df` degrees of freedom (NaN for df = 0: the data carry no information on the groups)

SurvdiffResult.var#summary.en: Variance matrix of obs - exp (array of rows)

SurvdiffResult.warnings#summary.en: R's warnings, each once, in R's order (an empty array when there are none).

SurvfitOptions.confType#summary.en: Transformation of the pointwise confidence intervals. Default `"log"`.

SurvfitOptions.group#summary.en: Group labels, one per observation: one curve per group. Omitted: a single curve.

SurvfitResult#summary.en: Result of {@link survfit}: the rows of R's `summary(fit, censored = TRUE)` and the medians.

SurvfitResult.lower#summary.en:
Lower limit of the pointwise confidence interval of S(t) (where S(t) = 1, 1 for each `confType`; with `"log-log"`
as survival 3.8-12, NA before it)

SurvfitResult.median#summary.en: Per stratum, [median, lower limit, upper limit] (NaN for R's NA)

SurvfitResult.nEvent#summary.en: Number of events at the time (R's `n.event`)

SurvfitResult.nRisk#summary.en: Number at risk just before the time (R's `n.risk`)

SurvfitResult.stdErr#summary.en: Standard error of S(t) (S times the standard error of log S)

SurvfitResult.strata#summary.en: Stratum of each row (`"group=<label>"`, or `"all"` for a single curve)

SurvfitResult.time#summary.en: Time of each row (the distinct times of the stratum, censored ones included)

SurvfitResult.upper#summary.en: Upper limit of the pointwise confidence interval of S(t)

coxph#@param status.en: 1 for an event, 0 for a censored time.

coxph#@param x.en: The covariate matrix, one row per observation (at least one column).

coxph#summary.en:
Cox proportional hazards regression. Equivalent to R's `survival::coxph()`. As
`coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ x [+ strata(strata)], weights, ties, init, control)` for right-censored data, with the
values of `summary(fit)`.

Rows with a missing time, status, covariate, weight or stratum are dropped. Times within sqrt(eps) of each other are
treated as tied. Covariates whose values all lie in `nocenter` are not centred; the others are centred by their
weighted means, which only shifts the linear predictors. R's warnings (non-convergence, possibly infinite
coefficients) are returned in `warnings`.

survdiff#@param status.en: 1 for an event, 0 for a censored time.

survdiff#summary.en:
Test of the difference between survival curves: the G-rho family of Harrington and Fleming, the log-rank test for
`rho = 0`. Equivalent to R's `survival::survdiff()`. As `survdiff(Surv(time, status) ~ group, rho = rho)`.

Rows with a missing time, status or group are dropped.

survfit#@param status.en: 1 for an event, 0 for a censored time.

survfit#summary.en:
Kaplan-Meier estimate of the survival function with Greenwood's standard error and pointwise confidence intervals.
Equivalent to R's `survival::survfit()`. As `summary(survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ group, conf.type, conf.int),
censored = TRUE)`, with the medians and their confidence limits of `summary(fit)$table`.

Rows with a missing time, status or group are dropped.
